sysd-reliab-007.caption: The quadtree is built by repeated splitting, then searched from the root down to the origin's leaf.

flowchart TD
A[Root: whole world map] -->|split into 4| B[Four quadrants]
B -->|split again| C[Leaves hold 100 or fewer]
C --> D[Walk from root to origin's leaf]
D --> E{Leaf has 100?}
E -->|yes| F[Return it]
E -->|no| G[Add neighbors' businesses]
